_comment: The SPA route table and its crawl policy, owned here and read by both consumers: frontend/src/routes.tsx builds the react-router table from it, and src/eco_mcp_app/seo.py builds robots.txt, sitemap.xml, the 404 rule for unknown paths, and the per-response X-Robots-Tag. Two hand-maintained lists is how the crawl policy drifts back out of sync with the router, so there is one.

routes.title: Eco via Sirens: server status and meteor countdown
routes.description: Who's online on the Eco via Sirens server, how long until the meteor, and how to join. Read live from the game server.

routes.title: Mods on the server | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: Every mod running on the Eco via Sirens server, linked to its source where one is published, with the reason where it isn't.

routes.title: Eco wiki shortcuts | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: Links to the parts of the official Eco wiki that players use most, checked by hand. The wiki on Strange Loop Games' site has the final word.

routes.title: Specialties and profitable crafts | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: Who on the Eco via Sirens server has each specialty, and which crafts pay best right now, ranked by profit times how many people want them.
routes.note: The wildcard swallows the retired server-rendered sub-paths (/jobs/professions). Only /jobs itself is canonical, so anything deeper renders but stays out of the index.

routes.title: What to buy, sell, and ship | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: The whole Eco via Sirens market on one page: what's moving, price history, every store, and what to buy, sell, and ship next.

routes.title: Crafting atlas | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: What the Eco via Sirens world is making: the most crafted items, the most gathered resources, and the busiest crafting stations.

routes.title: Every item in the world | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: Every item bought, sold, or crafted on the Eco via Sirens server. Open one for its trades, prices, who makes it, and who sells it.

routes.title: Item market and recipes | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: One item on the Eco via Sirens server: its market, the recipes that make it, and what it's used for.
routes.note: One page per item keyed by ?id= (the item id minus Item), holding market, recipes, and uses. The retired ?item= form redirects in the client. Thousands of URLs over one shell.

routes.title: Every Eco recipe | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: Every way to craft in Eco, filterable, and linked to each product's market history on the Eco via Sirens server.

routes.title: Recipe | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: Recipes live on each product's item page now, with the market history beside them.
routes.note: Kept so old links never 404: the page redirects ?id=<recipe> to its card on the product's item page (eco-app#8383).

routes.title: Civics and elections | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: Elections, voter turnout, citizenships, and settlements on the Eco via Sirens server, counted from the server's own civics data.

routes.title: What eco-app answers | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: Each page answers one question about the Eco via Sirens economy: what's in demand, where to buy and sell, how to price, and more.

routes.title: What's in demand right now | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: Items players on the Eco via Sirens server want but no store is selling, most wanted first.

routes.title: Food to restock or watch | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: Cooked, baked, and chef-made food on the Eco via Sirens server: what's in shops, what's wanted, what's selling, and what's been made.

routes.title: Where to buy and sell an item | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: Pick an item and see the cheapest shelves to buy it from and the best stores to sell it to on the Eco via Sirens server.

routes.title: Buy low here, sell high there | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: Items you can buy cheap at one Eco via Sirens store and sell for more at another, biggest total profit first.

routes.title: How should I price this? | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: Pick an item, see what shops on the Eco via Sirens server charge, and use the craft cost to work out your profit.

routes.title: Make it, buy it, or find a crafter | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: For any item: what it takes to craft, what shops charge, and who on the Eco via Sirens server has the specialty to make it.

routes.title: Check a shop against the market | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: Pick a store on the Eco via Sirens server and see which of its prices sit far above or below the market's middle price.

routes.title: World map, biomes, and climate | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: The Eco via Sirens world: its biomes, the climate and what to do about it, and which species are at risk.

routes.title: Species populations | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: How many of each species are alive on the Eco via Sirens world right now, and each one's population curve across this cycle.

routes.title: Cycle 14 in 3D | Eco via Sirens
routes.description: Places on the Eco via Sirens server in cycle 14, captured as 3D scenes you can look around in.
routes.note: Lists every /cycle-14/* route below, derived from this table (COI-2401). Noindex until Kai says otherwise, unlike the pages it lists.

routes.note: A Gaussian splat of the cycle 14 castle, with a still and two flythroughs (eco-app#8572, #8601). Indexed on Kai's say, 2026-10-01.
